turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and when?
That isn't an answer. Who entered it, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
You asked for this meeting. If you have nothing to say, I'll say it to the principal.
Are you finished? Because I stopped listening about five minutes ago.
I'm not finished, and you'll start listening. Who entered the zero, and why was I never called?
